field.name: contactAllowed
field.description: Y: the applicant agreed to be contacted about other openings

field.name: emailMessageId
field.description: The message an application by mail was made from, once

field.name: duplicateOfApplicationId
field.description: Another application of the same person to the same employer, open when this one was made: flagged for review, never merged

field.name: sourceKey
field.description: The chat message an application was made from (chat:room:seq), once (create#ApplicationFromChat)

field.name: externalProcessing
field.description: Y: the group's pay is calculated by an external processor (impl-people P28): its approved inputs are exported, its results imported through the payroll exchange; its runs are never calculated natively, and it may be live with no localization once Accounting's payroll-origin projection is in place

field.name: exchangeBatchId
field.description: The payroll exchange whose external results the run carries: its employments are never calculated here, and its approval binds the results as imported

field.name: finalizeMessage
field.description: Why a finalization is still pending (a unit or a payee bucket that failed), cleared once it completes

field.name: localizationPayeePartyId
field.description: The localization binding's payee: who is paid the localization's employee and employer amounts (impl-people P27)

field.name: localizationLiabilityGlAccountId
field.description: Where the localization's withheld and owed amounts are held until its payee is paid

field.name: localizationExpenseGlAccountId
field.description: The expense of the localization's employer amounts

field.name: payeePartyId
